purpose: Teach: 包み/吐い/おとなしく/しあわせ/ややこしい/蚊/いじっ/となり

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫からの包み、開けたら、お祖父ちゃんの似顔絵、入ってたよ、嬉しいよ、本当に。
lines.en: When I opened the package from my grandchild, there was a portrait of me inside. It made me so happy, truly.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried opening. Slight pause before 'portrait' as if seeing it again. Voice softens on 'happy' — genuine, unguarded. Slow trailing end, lingering on the gratitude.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。あなた、薬、飲んで、吐いちゃうこと、最近、あったわよね、心配。
lines.en: Yes. But you've been getting sick after taking your medication lately, haven't you? I worry about that.
lines.style: Gentle concern mixed with the matter-of-factness of long partnership. Slightly higher pitch on 'worry' — not alarmist, just present. Soft firmness underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんは、若い頃から、おとなしく、静かに、過ごしていたな、覚えてる?
lines.en: You remember, don't you? I've always been the quiet type, even when I was young.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful opening. Slight upward lilt on 'remember' — checking she's with him. Slow, reflective pace. Tone is soft remembrance, not self-pity.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃の私たち、結構、しあわせだったわよね、貧しくても、本当に。
lines.en: We were quite happy back then, weren't we? Even when we didn't have much. Really.
lines.style: Warm, intimate recall. Slight smile in the voice. Pace unhurried, savoring the memory. Gentle emphasis on 'happy' — not naïve, just honest about what mattered then.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 年金の手続き、ややこしい書類、年寄りには、つらいよな、ばあさん。
lines.en: These pension paperwork forms are so complicated. It's really hard on us older folk, isn't it, dear.
lines.style: Steady, slightly weary observation. Matter-of-fact tone without complaint. Gentle turn toward her on 'dear' — pulling her in as witness, not asking for pity.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 夏の縁側、蚊が、本当に多いから、網戸、もう、修繕しないとね、あなた。
lines.en: The mosquitoes on the porch in summer are getting worse. We really do need to fix that screen door soon, don't we?
lines.style: Practical, attentive to the home. Light, almost conversational tone — this is the work of living together. Slight upward lilt on 'don't we' — inviting her agreement, not demanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おもちゃ、孫が、いじって、楽しんでいたな、昨日、可愛かったぞ。
lines.en: The toy kept our grandchild entertained for hours yesterday. It was so sweet to watch.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender recollection. Slight brightness on 'entertained' — delight in small things. Soft, lingering close on 'sweet' — the memory still warming him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: となりのおばさん、ご主人、亡くなったって、お悔やみ、行きましょうね、あなた。
lines.en: The neighbor next door — her husband passed away. We should go pay our respects together, shouldn't we?
lines.style: Soft, respectful tone. Slight pause before 'passed away' — appropriate gravity. Gentle turn toward shared duty on 'together' — a quiet statement of their partnership.
